关于河岸的故事(A Story about the river bank): 一篇关于自然环境的A2短文:马克斯与欧文的经历和小计划。
Last Saturday, Max and Owen went to the river bank. Life is full of small surprises. Max usually has noodles for breakfast. For example, the tractor ploughs the field slowly.
Owen is interested in reading. Max is reading a book about math. There are always many people at the plant garden. Also, the zipper on my bag is stuck.
They took many photos at the plant garden. Max plays basketball with Owen every Saturday. Max hopes to visit Tokyo one day. What's more, I can see the sea from my room.
Max thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like noodles and tea. The river bank is one of the best places in the city.
